said.usage: usage: miyu im start | stop | restart | status | web | logs [-f] | venue show <venue> | whitelist [list | add <number> | remove <number>] | access [whitelist | group | skip <group>] [list | add <number> | remove <number>] (serve is started by the core only)
said.access/no-group: Group {group} is not listed: run miyu im access group add {group} first
said.no-log: The run log cannot be written: {reason}
said.web/not-running: Connect Messaging isn't running. Run miyu im start first.
said.web/open-by-hand: Open this in a browser (valid for 1 minute): {url}
said.notice/page-in-use: Web page port {port} is in use, so the page won't open. Pick another port (im.web.port); NapCat keeps working.
said.notice/disconnected: NapCat disconnected; waiting for it to reconnect.
said.notice/disconnected-as: NapCat disconnected ({bot}); waiting for it to reconnect.
said.failure/port-in-use: Port {port} is in use. Pick another: miyu config set --system im.qq.listen <port>, and change NapCat to match.
said.failure/crashed: Connect Messaging hit a bug and stops: {reason}
said.notice/no-token: No token (im.qq.token) yet, so NapCat will be refused. Open the Connect Messaging page (miyu im web) and paste the token from NapCat; it connects within seconds.
said.failure/not-spawned: No handshake reply from the core. miyu-im serve is started by the core only: turn Connect Messaging on with miyu im start.
said.control/started: Connect Messaging is on: the core starts it now and every time the core starts.
said.control/stopped: Connect Messaging is off: the core stopped it and will not start it again.
said.status/off: Connect Messaging is off. Turn it on with miyu im start.
said.status/waiting: Connect Messaging exited; it starts again in {seconds} s ({failures} failures in a row).
said.status/stopped: Connect Messaging stopped and the core will not start it again: {reason}
said.status/stderr: The last lines of its standard error:
said.status/missing: The core has no im package: its manifest is missing or wrong; check it with miyu check.
said.status/page: Settings and status are in the web app: miyu im web
said.status/misread: These settings could not be read, the rule files are used instead: {keys}
said.reason/config_error: a configuration error or a port in use (exit code 1). Fix it, then run miyu im restart.
said.reason/failed_repeatedly: it failed {failures} times in a row. See miyu im logs, then run miyu im restart.
said.reason/not_installed: there is no miyu-im program next to miyu.
said.reason/cannot_start: it could not be started: the system refused, or its directory or standard error file could not be made.
said.reason/protocol_mismatch: its manifest speaks a protocol version the core does not.
said.failure/factory: Connect Messaging cannot start: its factory data has problems (a packaging error):
said.venue/none: No rule sets anything for this venue.
said.venue/defaults: Parameters not listed follow the factory defaults.toml.
said.venue/problems: Problems found while reading (the wrong item, rule or file is not used; the rest is):
said.venue/bad-venue: Not a venue id: {venue}. Write <platform>:group:<group> or <platform>:private:<user>, for example qq:group:123456.
said.problem/not-an-option: {key} is not one of the options: {got}
